name: Recipes & Shopping Engine
changes: Nutrition now has PROGRAMME / JOURNAL / RECETTES / COURSES internal tabs
VOIR TOUT opens the recipe catalogue
VOIR LA RECETTE opens a functional recipe detail modal
Recipe cards include ingredients, preparation steps, prep time and macros
Recipe replacement writes the selected recipe into the closest-kcal programme meal and opens Journal
Shopping list is generated from the active nutrition protocol
Shopping items are grouped into proteins, starches, fruit & vegetables, dairy and pantry
Persistent MAISON / ACHETÉ states per day and active session
V6.22 training isolation engine and V6.21 Nutrition UI retained
known_limitations: Shopping list currently aggregates the active daily protocol, not a full seven-day generated week.
Recipe replacement picks the closest-kcal meal rather than performing ingredient-level macro optimization.
Recipe food photography is still represented by semantic visual placeholders.
